request.prompt: Images 1-4 are reference photos of the masked person; match the mask shape, colour and headphones exactly. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the mask, which keeps exactly its soft light mint-green paper colour from the reference images (do not saturate or brighten it) — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Full-body frontal portrait, centred, standing straight with arms relaxed at the sides, on a pure seamless white studio background: ONE person wearing the same soft light mint-green crumpled-paper Pac-Man ghost mask as the reference — same stepped dome top, same pixel zigzag bottom edge reaching the hoodie collar, same black plus-sign eyes, same paper texture and quality, crisp and detailed — but WITHOUT headphones and without microphone, nothing on the sides of the mask; plain mid-grey hoodie, black trousers, white sneakers. Neutral, motionless, like a uniform. Head to toe in frame with white margin all round.
